source.label: DEVELOPMENT_MEASUREMENT_ONLY
source.event_rule: All BTC-5m events in this hour identified by embedded market metadata and cross-checked token/condition identity; expected 8 events and 16 tokens; exclusions explicitly counted; no outcome-based event substitution
source.additional_dates: Only 2026-07-29 and 2026-07-30 at 08:00-09:00 UTC, if separately delivered and preregistered DEVELOPMENT_MEASUREMENT_VALIDATION before reading; no waiting or replacement

identity.group_rule: Require sample-period contract address, deployment and ABI verification. Match CLOB transaction_hash to chain tx hash; use actual decoded takerOrderHash and matchOrders makerOrders, then one-to-one reconcile OrderFilled by order hash, maker, token, side, asset amounts and fee. Do not infer true maker role solely by excluding taker hash.
identity.complement: Both token print routes and target maker legs included; receipt asset exchange sets each maker leg's direction, shares and price
identity.ambiguous: Unknown or duplicate joins are excluded from certified denominator and reported without replacement
identity.fixed_examples: At most 24 distinct transaction hashes: six each from single-maker, multi-maker, complement-token route and repeated maker-order use, in that priority order; candidate category is structural and determined before price/replay results; within each category sort SHA256('rocklabs-qop-v1-examples:'+txhash), skip already selected, take first six; if category has fewer, record shortfall without substitution. All three originally unlinked target prints audited separately without replacement.

replay.reference: Independently reproduce first event's 1495/2229 and 1883/2229 full-book snapshot-transition exact matches before changing replay rules
replay.normalization: Decimal price/absolute size per token, side and price; zero size deletes; compare numeric equality independent of JSON key and string ordering
replay.holdout: Investigate first chronological eligible event only; freeze any mechanism-grounded amended replay rule before applying it unchanged to the other seven events. Post-holdout change is exploratory and separately versioned.
replay.causality: Exchange-time sort is offline only unless receive-time precedence can be proved. Do not use future snapshot to choose order or copy reference book. Hash is not a sequence number without independent verification.

clock.gate: Per-leg match interval and error <=min(500ms, actionable_lead/4) must have independent mechanism or record support; format precision, small latency and later block time alone do not qualify
clock.unknown: Return UNKNOWN when no independent bound exists

publication: Only aggregate counts, code, source/config hashes and private evidence index hash. Raw rows, transaction/order/address IDs, signed URLs and credentials remain ignored under _private/.
